description: This is a Java source file defining a class 'SimplePlaceholder' used for testing purposes within the org.eclipse.ditto.services.models.connectivity package. It implements the Placeholder interface with String as the type parameter, providing methods for prefix, supported names, support check, and resolve logic.

classes.name: SimplePlaceholder
classes.description: A singleton implementation of the Placeholder interface for String type, used as a simple placeholder for test purposes.

methods.name: getPrefix
methods.description: Returns the prefix string 'test' for this placeholder.

methods.name: getSupportedNames
methods.description: Returns a list containing a single supported placeholder name, 'placeholder'.

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Checks if the given name is supported by comparing it case-insensitively to 'placeholder'.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves the placeholder by returning the placeholderSource wrapped in an Optional if the name is supported; otherwise, returns Optional.empty().
